name: @w6w-apps/nutshell
description: Read and write Nutshell CRM leads, accounts (companies) and contacts (people), and log notes, over Nutshell's JSON-RPC API.

w6w.longDescription:
Nutshell is a sales CRM built around Leads, Accounts (companies) and Contacts (people), reached entirely through a single JSON-RPC endpoint rather than REST resource URLs. This app covers the lifecycle a workflow actually needs on each: create, read, find/search, and update, plus logging a note against any of the three (or against a scheduled activity).

Every write follows Nutshell's own optimistic-concurrency model — updating a record requires the `rev` you last read it at, and Nutshell refuses a stale write rather than silently overwriting a concurrent change, so the update actions surface that `rev` requirement directly rather than hiding it.

Good for creating a Lead when a deal is qualified elsewhere, syncing company and contact records with an outside directory, searching for a Lead or Account by name before creating a duplicate, or dropping an activity note onto a record from another tool.
